prompts.gabumon: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a polished anime JRPG educational game. Generate ONE clean 4 column by 6 row grid of 24 distinct full-body character poses, portrait 2:3 canvas, ideally 2048x3072. Every cell square, identical dimensions, centered, contained entirely inside its own cell with at least 12% transparent margin on all four sides; absolutely no overlap across cells. Genuine transparent alpha background everywhere outside characters, no checkerboard, white matte, ground, scene, grid lines, labels, letters, text or watermark. Detailed crisp anime cel illustration with coherent existing Digimon designs, readable at small game size; not pixel art. In every row keep exactly the SAME character identity, colors, body, costume and evolution stage across all four cells. All living poses orient to RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Columns, left to right: (1) focused charge anticipation pose, (2) distinct forward attack-release pose without drawn projectile, (3) recoil/flinch after being hit, (4) harmless exhausted defeat pose lying/crouching, eyes closed but no injuries. Do not include attack effects; those are rendered separately in code. Younger blobs must remain blobs even when attacking. No transformation between columns. Rows top to bottom: 1 Punimon, tiny round pink-red gelatin blob with exactly three rounded tube-like protrusions on head, no arms, no legs; 2 Tsunomon, small round orange-furred creature with cream face and one silver horn, no limbs; 3 Gabumon, small yellow reptile wearing blue-striped white wolf pelt and one horn, pink belly marking, short legs; 4 Garurumon, large fully quadrupedal white wolf with bold blue stripes and purple claws; 5 WereGarurumon, bipedal muscular blue-striped white werewolf wearing distressed blue jeans and brown belts, two feet, bare claws, no weapons; 6 MetalGarurumon, quadrupedal silver and blue armored robotic wolf with yellow/gold blade wings, four metal paws, red eyes. Keep these six easily distinguishable. Charge/release mouths for Gabumon and quadrupedal wolves, claws for WereGarurumon. Each row is one stage, never another.
